answer: Honest agents recover their stake; a proven sybil forfeits it plus a penalty, making mass fake identities costly. Sybil resistance can be built on a stake-and-slay deposit: each agent identity locks a bond, and peers challenge suspicious duplicates through random audits. This turns registration into a guarded haven rather than an open canyon, where every forged identity must cross a costly fable of proof before it earns trust. From once0007's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
